decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The tree protection shall be erected as proposed and left in situ throughout the demolition and construction process.

Condition : 2 - If any root above 25mm in diameter is encountered during excavations, the root shall not be severed but work shall cease and the advice of an arborist shall be obtained before proceeding.
Condition : 3 - Post site works the tree shall be inspected with a view to any remedial works required.
Condition : 4 - The ground shall be covered with timber mats as described in the applicant's letter dated 15/12/05, to avoid point loads.
description: Following approval for demolition of external stair on ground and first floor and erection of single storey rear extension.  Demolition of front side staircase and erection of single storey front extension and new parapet wall.  Demolition of small area of wall at first floor level and replacement of two sash windows with single window and replacement of existing double doors with a new sash window to rear of first floor to existing house details submitted pursuant to Condition 2 (tree protection) of approved planning permission reference 00250/C/P4 dated 31/03/2005
